evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared domain is Conversational AI / LLM / Knowledge Graph, yet the entire portfolio consists of semiconductor hardware technologies (HBM4, Chiplet Integration, Advanced Packaging, Silicon Photonics) with only Vector Database Technology marginally relevant to the stated domain. A 기술선도 strategy in LLM/Knowledge Graph would emphasize exploratory AI model architectures, knowledge representation, and reasoning technologies — not chip packaging.
evidence.competitive_awareness: The company's stated domain is Conversational AI / LLM / Knowledge Graph, but virtually all selected technologies (HBM4, Chiplet Integration, CoWoS Packaging, Silicon Photonics) belong to semiconductor manufacturing and hardware domains where the company has no established competitive advantage. This represents severe domain drift — the company would be competing against TSMC, Samsung, and SK Hynix rather than leveraging its AI/LLM expertise.
evidence.market_timing: For a 기술선도 strategy, completing 1-2 years before the boom is ideal. HBM4 finishes 1 year early (good), and Chiplet Integration finishes ~0.75 years early (acceptable). evidence.patent_market_convergence: Vector Database Technology shows reasonable patent-market convergence for the AI domain, but the remaining six technologies are hardware semiconductor plays where the company has no patent portfolio base.
